title: MARLO Legalities
body:
We should have Terms of references, Privacy notice and Software Licence explicit in the platform.

- [x] Define texts in collaboration with CIAT Legal office
- [x] Share them with MARLO-Family
- [x] Release it into MARLO
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @htobon do you know about the progress of this issue ?

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Hi @sebas932.
The privacy notice is ready.
Please check the document located in: MARLO\2_Technical\2_2_Documentation\2_2_1_Manuals\Legal

The other sections are still in progress.

Cheers,

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: After a number of back and forths with the CIAT Legal office, we have come to a final version of the documents that were shared with MARLO-Family.
